name: wide-stance-cable-anti-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume an athletic position with your feet much wider than shoulder width and attach a rope to a cable stack at chest height.
2. Keep the arms locked out and rotate at the shoulders to bring the rope across your body.
3. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
